pitch.title: {name}: investor pitch
pitch.problem.smb: Small businesses lose hours every week to admin their software should already handle.
pitch.problem.enterprise: Large companies spend months and millions on compliance and security work that is still mostly manual.
pitch.problem.consumer: People want help with everyday life, but most apps are noisy, pushy and quickly abandoned.
pitch.problem.developer: Engineers waste a third of their week fighting tooling instead of shipping.
pitch.traction.growth: {g}% weekly revenue growth over the last 8 weeks
pitch.market.smb: Millions of small businesses, and almost none are fully automated yet.
pitch.market.enterprise: A few thousand large buyers with large budgets and long contracts.
pitch.market.consumer: Millions of potential subscribers at a low price point. Winning takes reach and retention.
pitch.market.developer: Hundreds of thousands of engineering teams who buy bottom-up.
pitch.market.share: We hold {share}% of the customers in our segment of this market
pitch.model.nocac: Growth is organic so far: no paid acquisition
pitch.fin.burn: {burn:money} net burn a week, {runway} weeks of runway
pitch.fin.raised: {n} rounds so far, {total:money} raised in total
scn.baseline.d: Gentle cycles and one correction in year one. Good companies grow; bad ones run out of money.
scn.ai-winter.d: Mania for 25 weeks, then funding freezes for six months. Who saved enough runway?
scn.bull-run.d: Money everywhere, valuations go vertical, burn rates follow.
scn.recession.d: Demand shrinks, churn rises, investors want profits.
scn.black-swan.d: Random violent shocks: crashes, demand spikes, outages.
ev.founded: {name} is founded: “{tagline}”. {cash:money} in the bank, {people} people. CEO brain: {brain}.
ev.seasonOver: Season over after {weeks} weeks. Winner: {name} ({brain}) at {valuation:money}.
ev.brainError: {brain} failed to decide ({msg}). Autopilot takes over this week.
ev.budget: Spend cap reached ({tokens:int} LLM tokens). {brain} is paused; autopilot runs the company.
ev.priceUp: Price increase: {from:money} → {to:money} per customer a week.
ev.priceDown: Price cut: {from:money} → {to:money} per customer a week.
ev.pivot: Pivot. {name} leaves {from:seg} for {to:seg}. Most customers are gone; the roadmap starts over.
ev.ship: Shipped: “{title}”. {name} won the bounty at {ask:money} ({bids} bids).
ev.bountyDone: Done: “{title}”. {name} won the bounty at {ask:money} ({bids} bids).
ev.bountyFail: “{title}” slipped. {name} missed the deadline; the bounty is unpaid.
ev.rejectedRich: {vc} passed: “you have {cash:money} in the bank, come back when you need it”.
ev.raise: {name} raised a {amount:money} {stage} led by {vc} at a {pre:money} pre-money valuation.
ev.review: Performance reviews: {top} leads ({topPerf}); {bottom} is lowest ({bottomPerf}). {low} on a performance plan.
ev.board: Q{q} board meeting: ARR {arr:money} ({qoq:pct} QoQ), {customers:int} customers, runway {runway} wk. {mood:mood}
ev.burnCut: The board mandates a burn cut: {count} people laid off ({names}); marketing halved.
ev.ceoOusted: The board ousts CEO {old} after valuation fell {drop}% from peak. {fresh} takes over (same {brain} brain, new face).
ev.bridge: Out of cash: {vc} wires a {amount:money} emergency bridge at a brutal {pre:money} valuation. Founders diluted.
ev.bankrupt: {name} has run out of money and shut down in week {week}. “It was an incredible journey.”
ev.unicorn: {name} is a unicorn, valued at {valuation:money} in week {week}!
ev.unicornFirst: {name} is a unicorn, valued at {valuation:money} in week {week}: the first in the league!
ev.shockFreeze: Shock: funding freeze. Investors stop writing checks overnight.
ev.shockMania: Shock: VC mania. Term sheets are flying.
ev.shockRecession: Shock: recession. Customers cut budgets; churn spikes.
ev.shockViral: {name} goes viral! A celebrity posted about it and signups explode.
ev.shockOutage: {name} suffers a 14-hour outage. Customers are furious; 10% leave.
hl.baseline.20: VCs say AI-native startups are “the only thing we look at now”
hl.baseline.44: Market correction: growth at all costs is out, “efficient growth” is in
hl.baseline.52: One year in: half of last year's startups have quietly shut down
hl.baseline.64: The correction is over. Investors are writing checks again.
hl.ai-winter.10: Seed rounds at 40x revenue are back. “This time it is different.”
hl.ai-winter.25: Funding winter: top VCs tell portfolio companies to “plan for zero”
hl.ai-winter.30: Customers freeze software budgets as the downturn spreads
hl.ai-winter.52: First green shoots: investors are “cautiously back”
hl.bull-run.8: A pre-product startup just raised at a ◈1B valuation. Everyone is hiring.
hl.bull-run.60: Analysts warn of a bubble. Nobody listens.
hl.recession.12: Central bank hikes rates again. “Profitability is the new growth.”
hl.recession.40: The layoffs tracker hits a record week
hl.black-swan.crash: Flash crash: tech stocks lose a third overnight. Term sheets pulled.
hl.black-swan.spike: Sudden demand spike in {seg:seg}: buyers are panic-purchasing
hl.black-swan.outage: A major cloud outage shakes trust in startups. Churn spikes.

setup.title: Put a model in the corner office.
setup.lede: Connect the AI providers you use, pick which models run which company, and watch them hire, fire, pivot and raise. Keys stay on this machine.
setup.privacy: Keys are checked by asking the provider for its model list (free), then saved to .agentcorp/config.json on this computer. That folder is git-ignored and keys never appear in logs or replays.
setup.name: Name
setup.noModels: Connect a provider above to choose real models. Until then the league runs on the offline strategies.
setup.startNote: Each LLM CEO decides every 4 weeks and is capped at 400K tokens. You can change everything later with “agentcorp setup”.
cli.wizard.title: setup
cli.wizard.keys: API keys (checked live, stored only on this machine)
cli.wizard.private: This file holds your keys. It is git-ignored; do not share it.
setup.freeNote: No budget? Free setup picks only models that cost nothing: a local Ollama, the free tiers of Groq and Gemini, and OpenRouter’s free models. Add a free key above (or start Ollama), then press Free setup.
setup.freeNone: No free models found yet. Start Ollama, or add a free Groq, Gemini or OpenRouter key above.
